Prepare an externally-supplied hydrolocation set for embedding

Source: R/hydrolocations_prep.R
prepare_hydrolocations.Rd

Maps a raw hydrolocation point dataset (e.g. the gage / assimilation points supplied by OWP) to the canonical hydrolocations schema that run_pipeline() embeds, and optionally writes it as a GeoPackage suitable for the hydrolocations_gpkg argument.

Usage

prepare_hydrolocations(
  x,
  flowpaths,
  mapping = character(0),
  max_dist = 1000,
  max_link_m = 250,
  link_keep_da_ratio = 100,
  link_keep_min_da_sqkm = 100,
  out_gpkg = NULL,
  layer = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An sf of hydrolocation POINTs, or a path to a point GeoPackage.

flowpaths

Reference flowpaths to snap onto: an sf or a path to the reference GeoPackage (its flowpaths layer is read). Required.

mapping

Named character vector mapping canonical column -> source column, e.g. c(hl_reference = "gage_id", hl_type = "type"). Canonical columns: hl_reference (REQUIRED), hl_type, hl_link, hl_class, hl_source. Anything unmapped/absent is filled NA.

max_dist

Max snap distance (m); POIs farther than this are dropped.

max_link_m

Max distance a point may be from the reach its source flowpath_id prescribes before that link is distrusted and the nearest flowpath used instead. Reported when it triggers. Default 1000.

link_keep_da_ratio

A distrusted link is restored when the nearest flowpath drains less than this fraction of the reach the source names (default 100, i.e. under 1%). Guards against relocating a large-river location onto an adjacent minor feature.

link_keep_min_da_sqkm

Only apply that rescue when the named reach drains at least this much, so the comparison is meaningful. Default 100.

out_gpkg

Optional output path. When given, writes the hydrolocations layer there and returns the path; otherwise returns the prepared sf.

layer

Layer to read when x is a GeoPackage path (default: first).

Value

The prepared hydrolocations sf, or out_gpkg when written.

Details

The POIs are snapped onto flowpaths and assigned flowpath_id, poi_id (one per flowpath, co-located POIs bundled), and linear-reference pathmeas/reachmeas. This pre-assignment is required: the refactor phase's spatial re-snap fallback is lossy (it drops many POIs when the input lacks flowpath_id/poi_id), so raw points MUST be snapped here first. Rows without hl_reference, or farther than max_dist from any flowpath, are dropped with a warning.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# OWP delivers gage points with columns `siteid` and `network`:
prepare_hydrolocations(
  "owp_gages.gpkg", flowpaths = "reference.gpkg",
  mapping  = c(hl_reference = "siteid", hl_source = "network", hl_class = "gage"),
  out_gpkg = "hydrolocations.gpkg")
# -> run_pipeline(reference_gpkg = ref, hydrolocations_gpkg = "hydrolocations.gpkg", ...)
} # }
